conviction_note: The print turns on one binary item, the $915M IQHQ/RaDD loan whose six-week forbearance ran out on 2026-10-09 and which management promised to update on the 2026-10-21 call; a 5% drop on Citi's note already prices distress, about 16% of shares are short at 13.5 days to cover, and the EPS bar ($1.43-1.45) sits below Q2's $1.49, so the findings net slightly positive (+0.5) while the scaled number is 0 at p_up 50: the direction of the IQHQ outcome cannot be sourced before the release, and that uncertainty goes into p_up, not into a smaller move.
bar: EPS $1.44 (Earnings Whispers, https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/OZK), $1.43 with revenue $433.3M (Benzinga, updated 2026-09-30, https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/OZK/earnings-forecasts), $1.45 (Unusual Whales, https://unusualwhales.com/stock/OZK/earnings). Three sources within $0.02, so the bar counts as sourced. Q2 2026 actual was $1.49 against $1.48 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/21/3330970/0/en/bank-ozk-announces-second-quarter-2026-earnings.html). Company guide: mid-single-digit full-year loan growth, average earning assets stepping up in Q3 and Q4, NIM a little under 4.20% (Q2 call, https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-bank-ozk-stock/).
positioning_check: Short interest 17.6M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up 6.6% from 16.5M, 13.54 days to cover on 1.3M ADV (https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/ozk/short-interest). On 109.04M shares outstanding (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/OZK) that is about 16% of shares, a crowded and growing short. Baseline: 25d skew +1.45 vol points (mild put bid), put/call OI 1.73, priced lean 'balanced', event-implied move 4.08% net of ordinary vol (front straddle 7.68% over 31 days; Unusual Whales quotes +/-7.1%). Tape: spot 46.21, 20d -1.72%, 5d +2.51%, 13% off the 52w high and about 12% down since the July print. The 5d bounce follows a >5% drop on the Citi IQHQ note around 2026-10-06/07. Sell-side: Citi Sell with a $40 PT (reiterated about 2026-10-13); TD Cowen Hold, PT cut to $50 from $52 about 2026-10-05; consensus Hold, average PT about $56.

findings.finding: The $915M IQHQ construction loan on San Diego's RaDD life-science campus (about 2% of a roughly $41.7bn balance sheet, completed in 2024 with almost no office/lab tenants) was given only a six-week extension to 2026-10-09, signed after the original 2026-08-26 maturity had already passed. Management said it would report the multi-year extension and recap with the mezzanine lender on the 2026-10-21 call. Citi read the extension as forbearance, and the stock fell >5%. The market's expectation is distress short of an outright loss, and the release will reveal whether the loan is recapped (relief) or downgraded, put on nonaccrual or reserved against (negative).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No usable print history in the baseline (FDIC filer). On this exact loan, the Citi note on the forbearance moved the stock more than -5% intraday (Bisnow 2026-10-07). Citi's May 2024 downgrade on the same San Diego and Atlanta loans also caused a sharp one-day drop (https://ampvideo.bnnbloomberg.ca/bank-ozk-shares-slide-as-citi-downgrades-to-sell-on-loan-worries-1.2078627).
findings.why_not_priced: The amended maturity passed on 2026-10-09 and the outcome (recap, further extension, or default/nonaccrual) has not been disclosed. The >5% drop prices distress, not a resolution. If a loss were priced, the stock would sit near Citi's $40 and the skew would be steeper than +1.45. If a clean recap were priced, the stock would not be down about 12% since July with a growing short. The sign is genuinely open, so the size is small and the range wide.
findings.independence: CRE Daily 2026-10-08 (https://www.credaily.com/briefs/bank-ozk-falls-5-after-citi-flags-915m-san-diego-loan/) rests on the same Bisnow and Citi material. Different sources: the Q2 call (July) says the loan was still pass-rated, the sponsor and mezz lender were in recap talks, and the ACL was adequate (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-bank-ozk-stock/). Citi's about-2026-10-13 note says a company update 'raises serious questions' (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/OZK). Brokerage listings still show about 767k SF available in Building 2B (https://www.commercialcafe.com/commercial-property/us/ca/san-diego/radd-2b-rise-1/).

findings.finding: Q3 has a visible pipeline of other problem assets that could keep net charge-offs high against management's July hope of getting back under the industry NCO rate for 2026. NCOs were $45.3M in Q1 and $56.2M in Q2 (vs $8.2M a year earlier). On the Boston life-science loan ($169.3M balance) the bank had a 'diminished assessment' of the pending $330M sale closing and said it was prepared to take title. The 808 Windsor fund faced foreclosure in August (Citi note).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed NCOs of $56.2M (up from $8.2M) with EPS $0.01 above consensus. The stock then drifted about -12% into this print (Unusual Whales), and the drift was mostly on loan headlines. No clean one-day reaction is available.
findings.why_not_priced: The 808 Windsor foreclosure and the Boston take-title risk are public, but their Q3 dollar outcome is not. A consensus $1.44 (below Q2's $1.49) leaves room for some provision. If heavy charge-offs were priced, estimates would have been cut in October (only one $0.01 Zacks move up was found) and the bar would sit lower.
findings.independence: 808 Windsor: Citi note via stockanalysis.com (about 2026-08-20, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/OZK), a separate asset from the Boston loan in Arkansas Business. Management's 'chunky NCOs, 10-12 classified assets, a few more over 18 months' is on the Q2 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-bank-ozk-stock/).

findings.finding: The EPS bar of $1.43-1.45 is $0.04-0.06 below Q2's $1.49, even though management guided average earning assets up in Q3 and Q4, NIM was 4.24% in Q2 (above its 'a little under 4.20%' guide), provisions have recently run below consensus according to the CFO, and about $175M of buybacks over the prior four quarters shrank the share count. A core beat of about 1% is likely unless the IQHQ resolution forces a large provision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat consensus by $0.01 ($1.49 vs $1.48) and the stock then drifted lower. Q1 2026 missed (Zacks: 'Q1 earnings miss estimates, expenses, provision rise', https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/2905646/bank-ozk-q1-earnings-miss-estimates-expenses-provision-rise-yy). This name has not paid much for small core beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus building in a QoQ EPS decline is visible in the estimates themselves. A market expecting a clear beat would not carry a 16% short. The lesson-1 caveat applies: the reaction to core beats here is damped, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Q2 metrics from Quartr (https://quartr.com/events/bank-ozk-ozk-q2-2026_33nYgvGY). Bar from Earnings Whispers and Benzinga (URLs in bar). The guidance and bar sources are separate; the Q2 metrics come from the same company release.

findings.finding: Peer regional banks reporting after OZK last spoke show improving credit. Regions (2026-10-16) had NCOs down 13bp QoQ to 29bp, adjusted EPS $0.73 vs $0.66 consensus, shares +2.27%. KeyCorp (2026-10-20) reported EPS $0.51 (+24% YoY) with 'improved credit quality'. This is a sector-tone proxy, not OZK's construction/CRE book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No OZK-specific history. The sector reaction to peer credit is the transmission. In October 2025, peer credit scares hit KRE by 6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced already: OZK is up 2% today and 2.5% over 5 days, partly on sector tone. Kept small because OZK's risk is idiosyncratic life-science construction lending, which these peers do not carry.
findings.independence: Proxy. Regions' 8-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001281761/000128176126000063/rf-2026930xexhibit991.htm). KeyCorp Q3 summary via MarketBeat (2026-10-20). One counter-datum: Western New England Bancorp missed on a single CRE charge-off (https://247wallst.com/cards/western-new-england-bancorp-inc-q3-2026-earnings-wneb-01kyn779kmvtvpn5mwc0w3ykpw).

findings.finding: Short interest rose 6.6% to 17.6M shares (about 16% of 109M shares outstanding, 13.5 days to cover) at the 2026-09-30 settlement, before the IQHQ forbearance note. Any IQHQ outcome short of a loss, such as a recap or a pass-rated multi-year extension, meets a crowded short with a squeeze mechanism inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print history. Lessons record that shorts at 18-23% of float squeezed 24-26% on non-negative prints, and OZK's long-running short has been built mainly on the CRE construction thesis.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is a mechanism, not a fact the price absorbs. If the squeeze risk were priced, the call skew would be bid. Instead the 25d skew is +1.45 toward puts and put/call OI is 1.73.
findings.independence: Equibles shows a similar 13.6-15.6% of float and 11.7-12.5 days to cover on earlier dates (https://equibles.com/stocks/ozk/shortinterest). Same underlying FINRA data.

findings.finding: Capital return continues: the quarterly dividend was raised to $0.49 on 2026-10-01 (the board acted after the IQHQ amendment was signed on 2026-09-30), and a new $200M buyback authorization (June 2026) is to be used 'depending on stock price'. At $46, about 12% below July levels and below the prior average buyback price, Q3/Q4 repurchases are likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Small. OZK has raised its dividend every quarter for years, so a raise carries little news.
findings.why_not_priced: The dividend raise is public and mostly priced. The Q3 buyback amount is not known until the release. The only signal is that a board raising the dividend the day after signing the IQHQ amendment did not see a capital problem.
findings.independence: Buyback usage and the new authorization from the Q2 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-bank-ozk-stock/). The $200M program authorized 2026-06-29 per a preview (https://www.itiger.com/news/1125928307).

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly positive against a mild put skew (+1.45), a put-heavy OI ratio (1.73), a -12% drift since July and a growing short. The crowded short makes the positive tail plausible, but the put bid and the unresolved IQHQ maturity say the option market sees the loan outcome as downside-weighted, so p_up stays at 50 rather than leaning long.
